issue.description: Worker function mutates shared `results` list via side effect instead of returning value. Makes testing harder and obscures data flow.
issue.suggestion: Return the index from worker and collect via `future.result()`: `results = [f.result() for f in futures]`.

issue.description: Custom JsonFormatter duplicates functionality available in python-json-logger or structlog. Adds maintenance burden and potential bugs (e.g., missing standard fields).
issue.suggestion: Replace with: import pythonjsonlogger.jsonlogger.JsonFormatter or structlog. Configure via dictConfig. Remove custom class.

issue.description: lease_interval, max_attempts, emergency_depth hardcoded in __init__; prevents environment-specific tuning and testing
issue.suggestion: Add optional parameters to __init__ with defaults; load from config object or environment variables

issue.description: Status and severity constants defined as module-level strings; no enum type safety or IDE autocomplete
issue.suggestion: Convert to Python enum.Enum classes (Status, Severity) for type checking and autocomplete

issue.description: apply_quarantine_policy() iterates all token matches with finditer() even for non-analytical fields. The is_analytical check at line 195 happens after payload length check at line 198, wasting cycles on large non-analytical payloads.
issue.suggestion: Move is_analytical check to line 193 (before any processing). Return early if not analytical. Also consider compiling TOKEN_PATTERN with re.DOTALL if newlines should be included in tokens.

issue.description: detect_high_entropy_tokens() calls _should_quarantine() which calls calculate_entropy() and _check_allowlist() for every token match. No caching of entropy/allowlist results for repeated tokens in same payload.
issue.suggestion: Add LRU cache to calculate_entropy and _check_allowlist (functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1024)). Since tokens repeat in logs, this avoids redundant computation.

issue.description: Configuration validation functions (_load_entropy_threshold, etc.) are repetitive boilerplate. Each does: get env, parse, validate range, raise ValueError. Could be consolidated into a generic validator.
issue.suggestion: Create a generic _load_config(name, default, parser, validator) function. Reduces ~50 lines of duplicate code and ensures consistent error messages.

issue.description: __init__ doesn't validate that loaded model actually produces DIMENSION-sized embeddings. Could warn or error early.
issue.suggestion: After loading model, test encode a dummy string and verify dimension matches self.DIMENSION

issue.description: Fetches all partition names then filters in Python. Could push date filtering into SQL for efficiency.
issue.suggestion: Modify query to compute partition date and compare in WHERE clause, reducing data transfer.
